# Codex Dream Skin source notice

Source: https://github.com/Fei-Away/Codex-Dream-Skin

Bundled free presets:
- Dream Portal abstract demo asset
- Gothic Void Crusade community-original preset

Not bundled:
- Arina Hashimoto portrait preset. The upstream NOTICE explicitly excludes those
  portrait files from the MIT grant, so users may only import their own
  independently authorized local copy.
- Documentation screenshots, which upstream states are not wallpaper assets.
